# Set71 current metadata reference

`current.json` is the frozen independent Python corpus, SHA256
`d8b3f965fe83272568042b21cf378c86c60f1d4d220a0ec92c1f837109f3756a`.
It covers exact public metadata, original capture IDs, revision CAS, bounded
reopen audit, malformed bytes and explicitly modeled export stages. Its model
identities authenticate no account, installed wallet or retained envelope.

Complete locked sources, all 75 public inputs and the portable reproduction
command are retained in the paired chain checkout at
`slug/testdata/hosted-current-recovery/reference`. Python 3.14.3 and 3.9.6 produce
identical files. Real-session and filesystem fault tests supply the separate
capability, owner, private-buffer and publication evidence.
